glossary.rsi: Momentum indicator: measures whether an asset is overbought or oversold.
glossary.macd: Trend indicator: compares two moving averages to spot a shift in momentum.
glossary.bos: Break of structure: price breaks a significant high or low, a sign of a possible trend change.
glossary.atr: Volatility measure: the average range of price moves, used to size the stop-loss.
